wallTimeExpectation: [I] Converting the 74 POLL sleeps will not move ReplayIT's wall time (about 1066 s, i.e. 18 min). Every POLL interval is 5-100 ms with deadlines of 2-120 s, so a converted loop saves at most one interval per wait. The elapsed time is browser, runner and DELIBERATE real-time waits (natural lease/grant/preparation expiry, the original run deadline in Order 26, 5 s Retry-After in Order 27, 1.1-3 s negative windows). AC-5 asks for before/after, not a reduction; report a flat time as expected (Dex RC-5, brief).

awaitilityFacts.apiNamesPresentInConditionFactory: pollInSameThread, alias, pollDelay, pollInterval, atMost, until(Callable,Predicate), untilAsserted, ignoreExceptions, failFast, conditionEvaluationListener [V constant-pool scan]
awaitilityFacts.pollDelayDefault: equals the poll interval; every converted loop that checked first must set pollDelay(Duration.ZERO) [I from Awaitility documentation, not run]

conversionRules: Only POLL rows are converted; DELIBERATE rows keep their sleep and their reason stays in sleep-table.tsv and the receipt (no code comment unless the site has none and the receipt needs one).

atMost = the deadline the loop already had; pollInterval = its interval; pollDelay(Duration.ZERO) where the loop checked before sleeping; pollInSameThread() always (sessions.transaction, ThreadLocal B1 state, p3 helpers are thread-affine or cheap); alias names the condition.

Behaviour-identical by default: where the original fell through to an assertion or returned the last value on timeout, use the private helper awaitLast (below), which swallows ConditionTimeoutException and returns the last observed value, so the caller's existing assertion stays the contract and no timeout turns a former pass into a new red. Rows marked MAP_EXCEPTION keep their exact AssertionError/IllegalStateException text; FAIL_AT_WAIT rows already asserted inside the loop.
No new @Test method, no rename (SINGLETON_METHODS, INCREMENTAL_METHODS and build.gradle.kts joinedDefaultMethods select by name; grep -c '^  @Test$' stays 73 and ParameterizedTest stays 1).
No weaker assertion; no change to the R10-rev2-2 wrapper-only diagnostic (STUDIO-OBS-009 AC-12), the 012A canary scan content, or any DELIBERATE window length.
